headword: {国民宿舎|こくみんしゅくしゃ}

definitions.explanation: A lodging run by a local government (or on its behalf) in a national park or scenic area, built so that ordinary people can take holidays cheaply. Many have hot springs and serve simple Japanese meals.

examples.japanese: {国民宿舎|こくみんしゅくしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{泊|と}まった→泊まる：10445_tomaru⟧。
examples.english: We stayed at a public lodge.

examples.japanese: {国民宿舎|こくみんしゅくしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧。

⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{温泉|おんせん}→温泉：04117_onsen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{国民宿舎|こくみんしゅくしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{泊|と}まった→泊まる：10445_tomaru⟧ものだ。
examples.english: On family trips, we often used to stay at a mountain public lodge with a hot spring.

notes:
Made of ⟦{国民|こくみん}→国民：02757_kokumin⟧ (the people, citizens) + ⟦{宿舎|しゅくしゃ}→宿舎：32454_shukusha⟧ (lodging). The system began in the 1950s, when holiday travel was spreading; since then many lodges have closed or been sold to private operators, and the word can sound a little old-fashioned.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {国民宿舎|こくみんしゅくしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{泊|と}まる→泊まる：10445_tomaru⟧: to stay at a public lodge
- ⟦{公営|こうえい}→公営：22485_kouei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{国民宿舎|こくみんしゅくしゃ}: a publicly run lodge

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{民宿|みんしゅく}→民宿：08165_minshuku⟧: a family-run guesthouse
- ⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧: a traditional Japanese inn
